subject: Benchmarking kickoff: latency & throughput acceptance for AurumPay onboarding
messages:
From: priyom_das
To: Danielle Price <danielle@aurumpay.com>
Cc: monica_patel, laura_bennett, neha_kapoor
Date: 2025-10-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Benchmarking kickoff: latency & throughput acceptance for AurumPay onboarding

Hi Danielle —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood. Per our onboarding discussion, we want to lock the acceptance criteria and the run cadence so your SREs and our infra team can schedule the load slots. Proposed acceptance targets for the first pass:

- Latency: p50 < 60 ms, p95 < 180 ms, p99 < 450 ms under steady-state
- Throughput: sustain 500 qps for 15 minutes with 95% success rate (we'll classify 5xx and 4xx as failures)
- Tail: 99.9th percentile token latency < 1s for the main request shape

Test plan highlights:
- Baseline (no caching) run to establish cold-start profiles
- Warmed run with KV/prefix caching enabled (we will share the exact cache keys)
- Burst window: 1200 qps spikes to validate graceful degradation/fallback policies
- Telemetry: per-token latency, queue time, GPU utilization, and model-level error rates

Can you confirm the SRE contact for scheduling and whether AurumPay wants the runs to originate from our us-west region or their EU presence? Also attaching a KPI matrix and a sample loadscript (loadscript-v2.jsonl) for the shapes we plan to run.

Next steps I propose:
1) Confirm SRE contact + preferred region by EOD tomorrow (Oct 8)
2) Redwood/Customer pre-check (15–30 min) week of Oct 13–17 to validate test creds and data subsets
3) Benchmark runs and result share the following week (Oct 20–24)

Thanks — looking forward.

— Priyom Das
Technical Onboarding Lead, Redwood Inference
priyom@redwood.ai

Attachments: aurumpay-kpi-matrix.xlsx, loadscript-v2.jsonl

From: Danielle Price <danielle@aurumpay.com>

Cc: Michael Chen <mchen@aurumpay.com>, AurumPay SRE <sre@aurumpay.com>
Date: 2025-10-07T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Benchmarking kickoff: latency & throughput acceptance for AurumPay onboarding

Thanks Priyom — this looks good. Confirming our SRE lead is Michael Chen (mchen@aurumpay.com). We prefer runs to originate from us-west initially; our EU region will be a follow-up pass.

A couple quick notes from our infra team:
- The 500 qps sustained target is ambitious for our current shard allocation; we might need a short capacity reservation window for the ramp.
- We can provide a sanitized traffic sample for the warm-run cache priming.

I'll loop Michael into scheduling. Tentatively ok with the Oct 20–24 run week but he will propose exact slots.

— Danielle
Head of Platform, AurumPay

Thanks everyone — quick update and attached updated loadscript.

What we changed in loadscript-v2 -> final:
- Reduced average payload size to match sanitized sample (from 2.4KB -> 1.9KB)
- Added a ramp stage: 0->500 qps over 5 minutes, hold 15 minutes, burst 1200 qps for 2 minutes, cool-down 5 minutes
- Instrumentation hooks: we will capture model tokenization overhead and queue wait times in addition to per-request latency

Michael — once you share staging creds I’ll trigger the 10-minute smoke run. Monica, I confirmed the Oct 14 1:30pm PST invite and attached the run checklist and the final loadscript file to the invite.
